name: Sora
source:
A mysterious shinigami, he killed a fellow shinigami on his first day of soul-hunting after graduating the Reaper Training School. Sora then escaped into the world of living and hid there. Powerful, he was an honour student during his training school days.

[spoiler]His true name is Kanno Akito.[/spoiler]

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/un_birth/chara_sora.html]official website profile[/URL].]
